description: Separate real bug found+fixed inside the fz-k22.10 option-B spike (reverted with the rest). When re-deriving a joined activation, using surface_inputs (the declared call-surface types) instead of the activation ActivationKey.inputs() TRUNCATES a closures capture slot -- surface_inputs is deliberately narrower than the activation (which carries capture inputs). Recompute/join must operate on .inputs(). Small, clean, correct-by-construction; extract and land independently of the larger machinery work. Verify against a closure-with-captures reduce fixture.
title: fz-k22: callsite activation recompute must widen the activation's own .inputs(), not surface_inputs -- surface_inputs is narrower and truncates a closure's capture slot
